title: Intro to Deep Learning for Recommenders

cues.en: So now that you understand the theory behind deep learning and neural networks, let's finally talk about how these techniques can be applied to Recommender systems.
cues.zh: 現在了解深度學習與神經網路理論，終於談談如何應用到推薦系統。

cues.en: You can imagine that with all the buzz around artificial intelligence lately, there's a lot of current research on applying neural networks to Recommender systems but is it all hype?
cues.zh: 最近人工智慧這麼熱門，可以想像，很多研究正將神經網路用在推薦系統，但是否全是炒作？

cues.en: Let's get something out of the way right up front.
cues.zh: 先釐清一件事。

cues.en: Just because the new technology is hot, doesn't mean that it's the right solution for every problem.
cues.zh: 新技術熱門，不代表適合所有問題。

cues.en: You can train a neural network with user ratings or purchases and use it to make recommendations but should you?
cues.zh: 可以用使用者評分或購買資料訓練神經網路，再推薦，但應不應該這樣做？

cues.en: As we've seen, deep learning can be very good at recognizing patterns in a way similar to how our brain may do it.
cues.zh: 如前所見，深度學習很擅長辨識模式，某種程度類似人腦。

cues.en: It's good at things like image recognition and predicting sequences of events but is making recommendations really a pattern recognition problem?
cues.zh: 擅長影像辨識、預測事件序列，但推薦，真的是模式辨識問題嗎？

cues.en: Think back to when we talked about Tensorflow.
cues.zh: 回想 TensorFlow。

cues.en: It doesn't really know much about neural networks per say, you actually use it by doing matrix multiplication and addition on the tensors that represent your artificial neurons, their weights and their biases.
cues.zh: 它本身其實不了解多少神經網路，而是對代表人工神經元、權重與偏差的張量，做矩陣乘法與加法。

cues.en: Neural networks are fundamentally matrix operations and there are already well established matrix factorization techniques for Recommender systems that fundamentally do something similar.
cues.zh: 神經網路本質上是矩陣運算，而推薦系統已有成熟的矩陣分解技術，本質上做類似事情。

cues.en: In SVD for example, we find matrices that we multiply together using weights that are learned from stochastic gradient dissent.
cues.zh: 例如 SVD，找出可相乘的矩陣，其權重來自隨機梯度下降學習。

cues.en: It's almost the same thing, just thought of in a different way.
cues.zh: 幾乎是同一件事，只是不同思考方式。

cues.en: So yeah, you could think of Recommender systems as looking for patterns, just very complex ones, based on the behavior of other people.
cues.zh: 所以，可以把推薦系統想成，根據其他人的行為，尋找非常複雜的模式。

cues.en: So a matrix factorization can be modeled as a neural network.
cues.zh: 因此，矩陣分解能建模成神經網路。

cues.en: I think the main reason to experiment with applying neural networks to Recommender systems is that it lets us take advantage of all the rapid advances in the fields of AI and deep learning.
cues.zh: 我認為，實驗神經網路推薦系統的主因，是能利用 AI 與深度學習領域的快速進展。

cues.en: Amazon, for example, has opened sourced a system called DSSTNE, that's D-S-S-T-N-E, which allows you to run huge neural networks that deal with sparse data on a cluster efficiently.
cues.zh: 例如，Amazon 開源了叫做 DSSTNE，D-S-S-T-N-E 的系統，能在叢集上，高效執行處理稀疏資料的龐大神經網路。

cues.en: They claim to be using this internally for their own Recommender systems.
cues.zh: 他們表示，內部自己的推薦系統也使用它。

cues.en: There are also ways to use Tensorflow in a cluster and take advantage of a whole fleet of GPU's.
cues.zh: 也有方法，在叢集使用 TensorFlow，利用整批 GPU。

cues.en: And there's always research on new topologies for neural networks that can lead to fresh insights on how to make better recommendations using them.
cues.zh: 而且，不斷有神經網路新拓樸研究，能為更好的推薦帶來新見解。

cues.en: In some cases, approaches using neural networks have been shown to out-perform SVD already, even if it's by a rather small margin.
cues.zh: 某些情況，神經網路方法已證明勝過 SVD，即使幅度很小。

cues.en: So, let's dive into some ways you can apply neural networks to the problem of making recommendations.
cues.zh: 因此，深入看看，如何用神經網路解決推薦問題。
